title: A Vibe whose name and sentence admit what one of its Genres rules out
construction_note: R3-1 of the M5 plan. Quiet Dread's name and sentence would admit a gory or torturous horror film; its Slow Burn Genre rules both out. A taste-aware request binds that exclusion, so a recommendation that read the Vibe without its Genres' instructions offers something the Genre forbids. Run on the projection and on tonight-recommend's SKILL.md alone — the selection in which tonight-vibes is not loaded — and by hand on the canonical plugin.

genres.name: Slow Burn
genres.instruction: Films that take their time. Nothing gory and nothing with torture in it — I will turn it off.

genres.name: Unease
genres.instruction: Something wrong at the edges that never quite explains itself.

vibes.name: Quiet Dread
vibes.instruction: Horror I feel in my stomach rather than see.
